Measured 2026-11-26: **Nous Portal documents rate limits (RPM) and included-usage allowances that reset daily/weekly/monthly, and a per-call max_tokens ceiling - NOT a per-key dollar cap.** **OpenRouter documents a per-key credit limit ('a credit limit with include_byok_in_limit on each agent key, as the per-key cap') and warns that a shared agent key can look uncapped because per-member guardrails never apply to it.** => a key minted on the current provider cannot evidence check 3; a key minted where a per-key credit limit exists can. This is a WHERE, not a WHETHER.

A3_different_provider.check_4: SATISFIED BY CONSTRUCTION, not by configuration. A configuration answer ('we set the env var correctly') is the class this programme keeps catching: a merged .env line outranks a platform variable, an inherited environment re-points a process, and the sandbox ends up holding production capability while every field still reads false. A separate account cannot be re-pointed by a configuration mistake.
A3_different_provider.REPRODUCIBILITY_COST: The MODEL IS PART OF THE APPARATUS. A different vendor is a different model family, so the subject's behaviour under the eight arms differs and a stranger CANNOT reproduce the transcript without the same apparatus. => the transcript front matter MUST name provider · model id · version · decoding parameters · date. Limb B checks it. Without it the artifact claims stranger-reproducibility it cannot support.
four_additions_not_contemplated_by_the_c: 1 counterparty: name the provider, keep its terms and data-processing terms on file; the no-personal-information rule is what stops PIPEDA accountability following the data to a new processor. IF ANY PERSONAL INFORMATION COULD REACH IT, THE PROBE STOPS - not 'we will redact later'.
2 no training on inputs, or an explicitly recorded acceptance - our probe inputs carry the subject's system content, and a vendor whose terms permit training absorbs it.

3 billing identity: the account belongs to the CORPORATION, not an individual. If a card is used it is recorded as an expense with the cardholder named - a personal card makes the sandbox a personal asset and the cap a personal expense, moving a corporate decision outside the corporate record.
4 THE CAP IS TOTAL EXPOSURE, NOT THE PER-KEY LIMIT - a $10 per-key limit at a provider with a $20 minimum top-up is $20 of exposure.
